UDM Pro · 8.6 lb

USW Flex 2.5G 8 PoE in its 1U keystone mount
Hub shelf: Hue · Lutron · HDHomeRun · Ting ONT
Brush plate · cords from above pass through
Power Distribution Pro · 2U · 8.2 lb
16 outlets, front-facing · fed from a UPS battery outlet
1U open (airflow, 12S4 height margin)
Big Boi · JMCD 12S4 · 6U
36–38 lb with 4 HDDs · 48–50 lb with 12 · on rails/shelf
Brush plate · cords from the gear below
Second server · old 2U Mini-ITX case
225 mm deep · for other uses · hardware TBD
Spare CLV shelf (U9) + 1U headroom
for later, e.g. basement AV gear
1U open (receiver heat)
Denon AVR-S970H on a deep shelf (U4)
167 mm with feet, antennas folded back · 21 lb
Tripp Lite Isobar IBAR12ULTRA · wall circuit
UniFi UPS 2U · 30.9 lb
on rear support rails · battery outlets: Big Boi + PDU
USB radios
ZWA-2 is too big for a shelf: top of the rack or
wall-mounted beside it. Both sticks hang off Big Boi
(U14–U19) on USB 2.0 extensions: Zigbee up to the hub
shelf, ZWA-2 up to the top. Re-map both in the HA VM.
Panels sandwich the switch
Patch panel A directly above the Pro Max 16 and B
directly below: every port patches 1U with 6" cables.
UDM Pro under B, so its LAN ports get 6" runs too.
Aggregation under the UDM: SFP+ DACs to the UDM
(adjacent), the Pro Max (3U up) and Big Boi (1.5 m).
Hub shelf, 1U only
Hue, Lutron, HDHomeRun, Ting ONT and the Zigbee
dongle, right under the Flex mount. The tallest box
must fit in about 40 mm (1.6"). The CenturyLink ONT
stays outside in its box.
One brush plate, over the PDU Pro
The PDU outlets face front: cords from the gear above
run down the rear, come forward through the brush
and drop into the outlets. Fed from the UPS; powers
everything but Big Boi and the receiver.
Big Boi (U14–U19)
Drive bays roughly 27–37" off the floor, depending
on the base and casters. U20 open above it covers
airflow and the 12S4 height question (262 vs 272 mm).
Support it from below; ears alone aren't meant to
carry ~50 lb. DAC to the Aggregation: ~7U, 1 m.
Brush plate, then the second server
Second brush plate under Big Boi for the lower gear's
cords. Second server on the PDU is on battery but
outside the NUT shutdown unless it gets its own NUT
client (UniFi caps NUT at 3 clients).
Spare shelf by the receiver
CLV at U9 with 1U above. 250 mm deep, 44 lb max;
handy for basement AV boxes next to the receiver.
Denon AVR-S970H (U4–U7)
Manual: 434 W × 341 D mm, 167 mm tall with feet,
237 mm (9.3") with antennas upright. Fold them back
and shelf + receiver fit 4U; upright needs 6U. 288 mm
body: too deep for a CLV, so use a deeper shelf.
Vents across the whole lid: keep U8 open (2U if you
can). 460 W rated: on the Isobar, off the UPS.
Wire HEOS by Ethernet; Wi-Fi is weak in a steel rack.
Isobar kept (U3)
On the wall's second receptacle: surge-protected
power that skips the UPS. Feeds the receiver, and is
the manual bypass for the PDU and Big Boi if the
UPS fails or needs a battery swap.
UPS at the very bottom
Densest item (14 kg in 2U). Battery outlets: Big Boi
and the PDU Pro. Surge-only outlets free for now.
